summary: The falsy test is a Pythonic falseness check, the opposite of truthy.
questions: How do I check if a value is empty or false-ish?
What's the opposite of the truthy test?

answer_card.title: falsy test
answer_card.answer_md: `value is falsy` checks Python-style falseness (e.g. `""`, `0`, `[]`). Opposite of `truthy`.
